title: Content Parts: Create Reusable Groups of Fields | Orchard Core
description:
Repeating the same group of fields on every content type takes time, and the copies drift apart. A postal address, with a street, a city and a postal code, is a typical case: a customer needs one for billing and another for shipping.

A content part holds a group of fields that you define once. Any content type can attach it, and a part marked Reusable can be attached several times to the same type, each time under its own name, with its own values.

In this video:
• What a content part is, and what Attachable and Reusable mean
• Creating a part on the Content Parts page
• Setting the display name, the description, Attachable and Reusable
• Adding Text Fields to the part
• Attaching the part twice to a type with Add Named Part
• Filling in a content item with two groups of the same fields
